artifact_note: Set by the session that publishes the dashboard (PLAN.md PR-3). The Routine fetches this URL to harvest ticks before republishing.
hpanel_baseline_note: Batched cost of the DB backlog on 2026-08-21 (5 sittings). The burn-down bar measures against this, so it only ever goes down as sessions land.
routine_note: Daily, 0 11 * * * UTC = 08:00 America/Asuncion (Decision D1). Paraguay is permanently UTC-3, so there is no daylight-saving drift to correct. Fresh session per firing, model claude-sonnet-5, push on. The prompt lives in ROUTINE.md — change it there first.
scan_note: Mon+Thu, 0 10 * * 1,4 UTC = 07:00 America/Asuncion — an hour before the daily nudge, model claude-sonnet-5, push off. Incremental: only repos pushed since their last scan are deep-read. Prompt lives in SCAN.md.
owner_timezone_note: The daily Routine reads this to work out "today" — the one-push-a-day and Sunday-silent rules are about the owner's calendar, not UTC. Changing it here changes the date the run uses; changing WHEN it fires is a separate update_trigger call on routine_trigger_id (the cron is UTC and cannot read this file).

timezone_history.why: owner relocating to Paraguay for 10+ months
